Role Title: Cozi Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Cozi Specialists to contribute to a customer's project focused on advancing family organization and household management solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Experienced Cozi users will have the opportunity to demonstrate live workflows, document best practices, and share insights into the most effective strategies for managing family calendars, shared activity planning, shopping lists, to-do lists, and household logistics. Key communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential as you articulate processes and provide clear, actionable input that will drive AI system improvement.

Scope of Work

  1. Demonstrate and document family organization workflows using the Cozi platform, covering calendar, to-do list, and shopping list features.
  2. Provide detailed insights and explanations about best practices for family coordination, including real-world use cases and common challenges.
  3. Create clear, concise written and verbal recordings showcasing step-by-step household management processes.
  4. Deliver feedback on Cozi's functionality, highlighting strengths and potential areas for enhancement within family management scenarios.
  5. Collaborate with the project team to refine AI data collection strategies based on lived experiences with Cozi.
  6. Contribute comprehensive examples of household task management, optimizing routines and shared responsibilities.
  7. Participate in knowledge sharing, offering guidance to maximize Cozi’s effectiveness for diverse family structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated expertise using the Cozi app for family scheduling, calendar management, and household coordination.
  2. Strong background in organizing shared family activities, appointments, and routines through digital tools.
  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to describe workflows and solutions clearly.
  4. Current access to an active Cozi account and comfort with demonstrating live management scenarios.
  5. Attention to detail and ability to articulate practical, real-world challenges and solutions.
  6. Experience with household task delegation, shared list management, and multi-user calendar optimization is highly valued.
  7. Familiarity with AI concepts and digital training platforms is a plus, though not required.
